# (voicetag utils AudioLoadError TP shape)
lang: python
file: utils.py
---
class AudioLoadError(Exception):
    pass

def load_audio(path):
    try:
        data, sr = sf.read(str(path), dtype="float32")
    except Exception as exc:
        raise AudioLoadError(f"Cannot read audio file: {exc}") from exc
    return data, sr
